newsitem.title: NIGERIA: World Bank official visits Nigeria to see projects.
newsitem.headline: World Bank official visits Nigeria to see projects.

text.p: A senior World Bank official has begun a five-day visit to Nigeria during which he is expected to hold talks with several government officials and inspect key Nigerian projects, a bank spokesman said on Friday.
A bank executive director, Joaquim Carvalho, arrived on Thursday and was due to hold talks with government on the economy and World Bank projects in Nigeria, spokesman Obadiah Tohomdet said.
Before meeting with government functionaries, he would inspect agricultural projects, petroleum production facilities and the $4 billion Nigerian Liquefied Natural Gas project, the spokesman added.
Carvalho is also expected to hold talks with key private sector figures in the commercial hub of Lagos before leaving on Tuesday.
In 1993, the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) gave a $9.6 million loan to Nigeria for agricultural and community projects in the northern Sokoto state.
The World Bank is the implementing agency for the project.
